01 / THE ENGINE✳

Every position.
A possibility.

Nest is a chess engine: a program that explores positions, weighs possibilities, and chooses a move.

Built in C++20, Nest combines alpha-beta search with neural network evaluation. It connects to UCI-compatible chess interfaces and supports multi-threaded search. Curious about the details? The source is a place to start.
